def reverseAcc : List α → List α → List α
  | [], acc => acc
  | x :: xs, acc => reverseAcc xs (x :: acc)

theorem reverseAcc_fusion (xs ys acc : List α) : reverseAcc (xs ++ ys) acc = reverseAcc ys (reverseAcc xs acc) := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp
  | cons x xs ih =>
    simp_all only [List.cons_append, List.nil_append, reverseAcc]
    rw [← congrArg (λ l, l ++ acc) ih]
    simp [List.append_assoc]

def reverseAcc : List α → List α → List α
  | [], acc => acc
  | x :: xs, acc => reverseAcc xs (x :: acc)

theorem reverseAcc_fusion (xs ys acc : List α) : reverseAcc (xs ++ ys) acc = reverseAcc ys (reverseAcc xs acc) := by
  induction xs generalizing acc with
  | nil => simp [List.append_nil]
  | cons x xs ih =>
    simp [List.cons_append, reverseAcc] at *
    rw [ih (x :: acc)]
    exact congrArg2 _ ih.symm.trans (rfl)
    simp [List.app_assoc]
